summary: Full e2e review of Veloura (backend + frontend). 15/15 backend pytest cases pass. All frontend flows verified: home, shop/nav filters, PDP size+add-to-cart, cart drawer qty/remove, checkout auth gating, address form + /orders/create + Razorpay modal opens (LIVE key, modal closed immediately, no payment), orders page shows pending + failed orders. Session auth via mongosh-seeded session token.

issues: Radix warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` for DialogContent — a11y warning only, add SheetDescription or aria-describedby={undefined} suppression.
Console warning about scroll container needing non-static position (framer-motion useScroll target) — cosmetic.

action_items: (Optional) Add SheetDescription/aria-describedby to CartDrawer SheetContent to silence Radix a11y warning.
(Optional) Add position:relative on hero scroll container to remove framer-motion warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py stores order timestamps as ISO strings (created_at) but queries session.expires_at as datetime — types are inconsistent across collections; consider consistent BSON Date for sortability.
Razorpay LIVE key is exposed via /api/orders/create response (key_id) — this is required for client checkout, but ensure only public key_id is returned (currently correct; secret only in .env).
No stock/inventory validation on order creation — infinite qty accepted. Consider min qty > 0 (currently uses max(1, qty) which silently corrects invalid input rather than 400).
Auth cookie is set with SameSite=None and Secure=True — good for cross-site; cookie also readable server-side only via HttpOnly.
seed_data_creation: Inserted 1 test user + 1 session in MongoDB test_database via mongosh. Also created 1 pending order (ord_a04513de124c) and 1 failed order (ord_574a2e93e816) as by-products of order-create/verify tests; these are safe leftover fixtures for regression.
